message: Hey neighbors! 🏡 I recently stumbled upon this helpful resource about fire preparedness from the Red Cross, and let me tell you, it's a treasure trove of practical tips. It’s always good to be a little over-prepared, right? You never know when you might need to know the best way to keep your home safe. Remember, a calm mind and a little planning can go a long way! What’s your favorite tip for staying prepared?
